svg.aria-label: The three descriptor blocks that turn signals on, when each applies in a run, what each reads or sends, and what each can do to the ledger CVE.
svg.title: Turning signals on, read for the ledger CVE
svg.desc: config.exploitability with kev and epss set to cache: the feeds are read from ~/.draugr/feeds at the start of the run and applied as each finding is ranked, in phase 2; the scan reaches no network. It can raise the ledger CVE from high to critical, P1. config.dependencyHealth with enabled true: applied once every scanner has finished, in phase 3; it sends deps.dev the list of packages during the scan. It can raise the ledger CVE to critical, P1, if its package is malicious or its version deprecated. config.reachability with analyzers govulncheck: govulncheck runs in phase 2 and its verdict applies in phase 3; Go only, and it needs a Go toolchain. It can lower the ledger CVE one level to medium, which leaves it in P2.
svg.text: CONFIGURATION · WHAT EACH BLOCK CAN DO TO THE LEDGER CVE
read at start, applied at ranking
runs in phase 2, applied in phase 3
your Go code; needs a toolchain
Dependency health is off by default. Reachability is Go only.
